title: Resident Evil: Apocalypse
desc: Alice wakes up to find that Raccoon city is infested with zombies and monsters. Later, she tries her best to find a way out of the city before it is too late.

title: Never Back Down 2: The Beatdown
desc: Four fighters with different backgrounds come together to train under an ex-MMA and ultimately have to fight each other.

title: Salt
desc: A CIA agent goes on the run after a defector accuses her of being a Russian spy.

title: Alpha
desc: Abandoned and alone, Keda, a tribal chief's son, forges an unlikely bond with a lone, injured wolf. Together, they navigate the harsh wilderness and fight for survival.

desc: Kraven, driven by vengeance and shaped by his father's cruelty, becomes the world's most feared hunter. His journey blurs the line between justice and obsession as he seeks redemption.

title: Morbius
desc: Suffering from a rare blood disorder, Dr. Morbius takes a risky leap to cure himself and others, inadvertently unleashing a dark and unforeseen consequence.

desc: Eddie Brock and Venom face alien threats and a relentless soldier, forcing them to make a life-altering choice.

title: Anaconda

title: Gran Turismo
desc: Underdogs risk everything to compete in high-stakes championships, overcoming insurmountable odds, personal hardships, and intense rivalries to achieve sports glory and inspiring triumph.

title: After Earth
desc: General Cypher and his son crashland on Earth 1000 years after cataclysmic events forced humanity to abandon Earth for a new planet.

title: The International
